meta.title: Juanberto's — California Burritos
meta.description: Hand-rolled California burritos. Carne asada, fries inside, no nonsense.

hero.headline: Burritos that taste like a road trip to San Diego.
hero.sub: Carne asada, fries inside, every layer counts. Hand-rolled in Mexico City.

story.body: It's the burrito they don't tell you about in your Spanish class. Born in San Diego. Carne asada, french fries inside, guacamole, cheese, pico. That's the rule. We don't break the rule.

papas.title: Papas adentro
papas.body: French fries inside the burrito. That's the rule. That's the whole rule.

asada.title: Carne asada
asada.body: Grilled on the plancha, not microwaved. The smoke is the seasoning.

manos.title: Hand-rolled
manos.body: Every burrito wrapped by a human. No machines. No shortcuts.

sandiego.title: San Diego recipe
sandiego.body: We learned from the source. No reinterpretations, no fusion, no nonsense.

quotes.quote: The California burrito of my life. I promise.

quotes.quote: Fries inside. As it should be. The end.

quotes.quote: My kids ask to come every Friday.
